The Anne Rowling Clinic Regenerative Neurology Scholarships 2021-22 is for online learning postgraduate programme applicants. Candidates interested in pursuing the online postgraduate certificate, diploma, or master's Stem Cell and Translational Neurology programmme in the academic year 2021-22 can apply for this scholarship to avail coverage of 60 credits towards the module fees.

The scholarship is open to applicants who have been accepted for admission to the online learning postgraduate Certificate, Diploma, or Masters Stem Cell and Translational Neurology program at the University of Edinburgh for the 2021-2022 academic session.
Applicants already offered a place at the University of Edinburgh should accept the offer to be eligible for this scholarship.
The scholarship recipients can benefit from the following-
One International Anne Rowling Clinic Regenerative Neurology Scholarship will be offered to cover
Two Anne Rowling Clinic Regenerative Neurology Scholarships will be offered to cover
Follow the below steps to apply-
Apply to the relevant programme at the University of Edinburgh.
After acceptance of the offer from the University, begin the scholarship application process.
Login using the University username and password or register as a new user.
Fill in the scholarship application form with the required details.
The scholarships will be awarded on the basis of academic merit.
The university will offer three online learning Master's scholarships.
The scholarships will be offered only to candidates from eligible countries.
